nodes.title: Simulate-hypothesis deadline input hotfix
nodes.summary: The single corrective task that makes production-simulate-hypothesis.factory.ts accept now and deadline as caller-supplied inputs, the same way its sibling simulate.factory.ts already does, instead of computing its own deadline from an internal, undecided constant.

nodes.title: Simulate-hypothesis's factory takes now/deadline from its caller, like simulate-case's already does, and the pipeline still bounds each stage by it
nodes.summary: Fixes production-simulate-hypothesis.factory.ts to accept now and deadline as caller-supplied inputs, removing its own internal TOTAL_DEADLINE_BUDGET_MS constant, so simulate-hypothesis stops inventing an undecided total and instead follows the same pattern its sibling simulate.factory.ts already uses for simulate-case — with the accepted deadline still reaching and bounding the pipeline's own stages, never merely accepted and discarded.
